rationale: Approved after the code-review.check round (approve/low). Original round: request-changes with one blocking finding, resolved in fix-up commit 681aab106: CR-001 (renderedBudgets in CostCenterBudgetRollupCard lacked the projectCount > 0 guard that CategoryCard already uses, so stale budget rows with mixed durations were rendered when no projects were linked; it now uses the same guard, with a regression test). No spec/story was supplied, so business acceptance is n/a and confidence remains low. Review covered the codemie-ui repo only (CostCenterBudgetRollupCard). Commit-format and security checks pass; the code-quality standard is absent from the repository. The round-1 verdict is preserved in decisions.jsonl.

standards_review.notes: The latest 12 commit subjects on the branch follow the documented EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence format (non-zero ticket id, uppercase first word, no trailing period).
No .ai-run/guides/standards/code-quality.md exists in the repository; absent standard.

The latest commit's four changed files introduce no HTML sinks, untrusted navigation, cross-window messages, browser configuration reads, or secrets. The store request continues to encode the cost-center id.

findings.title: Rollup renders stale budget rows with no linked projects
findings.problem: renderedBudgets does not apply the projectCount > 0 guard that CategoryCard uses, so stale budget rows with mixed durations are still rendered when a category has no linked projects.
findings.impact: The card can show a mixed-period header and a reset-period suffix for a cost center whose categories all read 'No projects linked', which misreports the budget period.
findings.recommendation: Apply the same projectCount > 0 guard in renderedBudgets as in CategoryCard, and add a regression test with stale mixed-duration rows and zero linked projects.
